# Lenovo ThinkPad Thunderbolt 5 Smart Dock 7500 — Thunderbolt 5 enterprise docking station

**Category:** Docking Station
**MSRP:** $519.99

## Tech Specs

| Spec | Detail |
|---|---|
| Host interface | Thunderbolt 5, up to 120 Gbps (80/120 Gbps) |
| Host cable | Integrated 1 m Thunderbolt 5 cable (removable, recessed bay) |
| Host charging | PD 3.1, up to 180W |
| Power adapter | 265W (included), with power connector lock |
| Video outputs | 2 × DisplayPort 2.1, 1 × HDMI 2.1, 2 × Thunderbolt 5 downstream (video-capable) |
| Max display config | 3 × 8K @ 60Hz + 1 × 4K @ 60Hz, or 2 × 4K @ 240Hz + 2 × 4K @ 120Hz |
| Thunderbolt 5 downstream | 2 × Thunderbolt 5 (80/120 Gbps, 15W each) |
| USB-C | 2 × USB-C 3.2 Gen 2 (10 Gbps), both always-on, 15W |
| USB-A | 3 × USB-A 3.2 Gen 2 (10 Gbps); 1 × always-on 12W, 2 × 5W |
| Ethernet | RJ45, 2.5 Gbps; Wake-on-LAN, PXE boot, MAC address pass-through on ThinkPad notebooks |
| Audio | 3.5 mm combo audio jack (front) |
| Security | Dual Kensington lock slots (NanoSaver + MicroSaver) |
| Intel certifications | Intel Evo, Intel vPro |
| OS support | Windows 10 and above, macOS Sequoia, macOS Sonoma (Linux per retailer listings) |
| IT management | Lenovo Accessories Fleet Manager (LAFM), cloud console on AWS |
| Dimensions (dock) | 235 × 80 × 30 mm (9.25" × 3.15" × 1.18") |
| Weight (dock w/ cable) | 586 g (1.29 lb) |
| Weight (adapter) | 800 g (1.76 lb) |
| Packed dimensions | 260 × 165 × 74 mm; 1730 g (3.81 lb) |
| Materials / ESG | 90% post-consumer recycled exterior casing; plastic-free FSC-certified packaging; TÜV carbon footprint certified |
| Mounting | Mounting slots on underside |
| In the box | Dock with integrated 1 m TB5 cable, 265W power adapter, user guide & warranty |
| Warranty | 3 years (CRU) |
| Part number | 40BA0265US (40BA0265xx by region) |

## Notable Features
- First-generation Thunderbolt 5 dock with up to 120 Gbps bandwidth — enough headroom for triple 8K60 or dual 4K240 without DisplayLink compression
- 180W PD 3.1 host charging, sized for ThinkPad P-series mobile workstations that outrun the typical 100W dock ceiling
- Native DP 2.1 ×2 and HDMI 2.1 outputs plus two downstream TB5 ports, giving four discrete display paths
- Lenovo Accessories Fleet Manager (LAFM) enables remote firmware updates, configuration, monitoring, and diagnostics across an entire dock fleet from a browser
- 2.5GbE with WOL, PXE boot, and MAC pass-through for enterprise imaging and network-policy workflows on ThinkPads
- Integrated, removable host cable stored in a recessed bay for clean desk routing and safe shipping
- Dual Kensington lock slots and a locking DC power connector for physical security
- Built from 90% recycled plastic with plastic-free packaging and TÜV carbon certification
- Display and charging claims are host-dependent — the laptop's GPU, display controller, and TB5 port must support the full configuration
